page.overview:
What is Spacecraft?

Spacecraft is a catch-all non-canon plane subtype featured on several Planechase cards in Doctor Who.

Spacecraft is a catch-all planar type that has been used to represent a location on a spacecraft traveling through space rather than being on a specific planet. Two such locations are the Mondassian Colony Ship and the Dining Car. The Mondassian Colony Ship was a ship that was traveling from [https://tardis.fandom.com/wiki/Mondas Mondas] to pick up some colonists. When the ship almost traversed into a black hole, the crew experienced the effects of time dilation that caused time on the higher levels of the ship to slow down in comparison to the lower floors, to the point that a thousand years passed on the lowest floor in the space of less than two and a half days on the flight deck. The second location is the Dining Car which is part of a spacecraft that was a reproduction of the Orient Express that traveled in space along hyperspace ribbons. It attempted to recreate the land-based Orient Express down to the fine details.
